ThemeBlocks.description: The block of each role. Each role has a block of its own.

ceiling_light.description: Lights hanging from the ceiling (a lantern).
ceiling_light.title: Ceiling Light

ceiling_web.description: A hallway's webs where a wall meets the ceiling (a cobweb, minecraft:cobweb).
ceiling_web.title: Ceiling Web

floor_border.description: The floor along the walls and in the doorways (a full block).
floor_border.title: Floor Border

floor_variant.description: Patches and patterns in the floor (a full block).
floor_variant.title: Floor Variant

pillar.description: The shafts of pillars (a full block).
pillar.title: Pillar

slab.description: Profiles: ledges and the balcony's deck (a slab).
slab.title: Slab

stairs.description: Profiles: mouldings, corbels, steps (a stairs block).
stairs.title: Stairs

storage.description: A hallway's lone container against a wall, which a run keeps a quarter of the time (a barrel, minecraft:barrel).
storage.title: Storage

wall_base.description: The bottom row of the walls and the pillars (a full block).
wall_base.title: Wall Base

wall_body.description: The walls between base and cornice (a full block).
wall_body.title: Wall Body

wall_body_cracked.description: Cracked patches in the wall body (a full block).
wall_body_cracked.title: Wall Body Cracked

wall_body_mossy.description: Mossy patches in the wall body (a full block).
wall_body_mossy.title: Wall Body Mossy

wall_cornice.description: The top row of the walls, under the ceiling (a full block).
wall_cornice.title: Wall Cornice

wall_growth.description: A hallway's growth hanging from the top of its walls (a vine, minecraft:vine).
wall_growth.title: Wall Growth

wall_light.description: Lights on the walls (a wall torch, e.g. minecraft:wall_torch).
wall_light.title: Wall Light

description:
A theme: the block of every role the room generator builds with. W4 turns themes into processor lists that
swap one theme's blocks for another's (architecture 15.2).
